title: Dangerous PHP construct (parsestr) — review required
description: PHP evaluates or includes dynamically: parse_strs*(s*$_(?:GET|POST|REQUEST)s*) (parsestr). Backticks run shells, variable includes load attacker paths, extract and parse_str overwrite variables, and /e evaluates replacements. This lexical rule flags the construct; the reviewer removes it via a result array.
remediation: Remove or use a result array.
